# Complete Fold reversible-computation model

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001`

## WHY

Complete Fold reversible-computation model must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: canonical configurations; bijective transition rows; retained held labels; exact inverse traces; universal reversible interpretation; complete resource ledger.

Boundary:

> All finite reversible computation structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. This theorem is formal and does not assign thermodynamic energy without a later physical measurement law.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced reversible computation kernel retains canonical configurations; bijective transition rows; retained held labels; exact inverse traces; universal reversible interpretation; complete resource ledger; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: canonical configurations; bijective transition rows; retained held labels; exact inverse traces; universal reversible interpretation; complete resource ledger.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact reversible computation record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-REVERSIBLE-MODEL-001

## Boundary and exclusions

This theorem is formal and does not assign thermodynamic energy without a later physical measurement law.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- This theorem is formal and does not assign thermodynamic energy without a later physical measurement law.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: reversible computation, Bennett machine.

    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:

        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)

    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Fold quantum information-unit law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001`

## WHY

Fold quantum information-unit law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: one Fold distinction; two held fibre labels; complete word support; exact observation classes; retained phase-label carrier.

Boundary:

> All finite quantum information units structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. The unit is structural support, not an imported complex vector or conventional qubit.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced quantum information units kernel retains one Fold distinction; two held fibre labels; complete word support; exact observation classes; retained phase-label carrier; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: one Fold distinction; two held fibre labels; complete word support; exact observation classes; retained phase-label carrier.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact quantum information units record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-INFORMATION-UNIT-001

## Boundary and exclusions

The unit is structural support, not an imported complex vector or conventional qubit.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- The unit is structural support, not an imported complex vector or conventional qubit.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: qubit, quantum information unit.

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(self.spec.generation_rule, self.spec.grammar_boundary, len(records), sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)), tuple(Candidate(str(r["candidate_id"]), str(r["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, r))) for r in records))

decide_candidate — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:127
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

closure_evidence — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:133
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

ORIGINAL DERIVATION DOCUMENT — claims/SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001/WHY_DERIVATION_CHECK.md
# Superposition-equivalent Fold support law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001`

## WHY

Superposition-equivalent Fold support law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: complete b^k Fold-word support; one record per branch; held phase label per branch; no selected actual branch before observation; exact support provenance.

Boundary:

> All finite superposition-equivalent structure structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. No amplitude magnitude, normalization constant or stochastic ontology is imported.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced superposition-equivalent structure kernel retains complete b^k Fold-word support; one record per branch; held phase label per branch; no selected actual branch before observation; exact support provenance; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: complete b^k Fold-word support; one record per branch; held phase label per branch; no selected actual branch before observation; exact support provenance.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact superposition-equivalent structure record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-SUPERPOSITION-001

## Boundary and exclusions

No amplitude magnitude, normalization constant or stochastic ontology is imported.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- No amplitude magnitude, normalization constant or stochastic ontology is imported.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: superposition, basis support.

# Fold phase and interference operation law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001`

## WHY

Fold phase and interference operation law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: period-b held phase cycle; reversible phase action; total branch-to-image relation; complete predecessor fibres; same-image merge ledger; retained phase provenance.

Boundary:

> All finite phase and interference structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. Interference is exact predecessor merging with phase labels; no complex exponential is assumed.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced phase and interference kernel retains period-b held phase cycle; reversible phase action; total branch-to-image relation; complete predecessor fibres; same-image merge ledger; retained phase provenance; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: period-b held phase cycle; reversible phase action; total branch-to-image relation; complete predecessor fibres; same-image merge ledger; retained phase provenance.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact phase and interference record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-PHASE-INTERFERENCE-001

## Boundary and exclusions

Interference is exact predecessor merging with phase labels; no complex exponential is assumed.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- Interference is exact predecessor merging with phase labels; no complex exponential is assumed.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: phase, interference.

    @property
    def registration(self) -> ClaimRegistration:

generate_candidates — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:123
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(self.spec.generation_rule, self.spec.grammar_boundary, len(records), sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)), tuple(Candidate(str(r["candidate_id"]), str(r["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, r))) for r in records))

decide_candidate — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:127
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

closure_evidence — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:133
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)

            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),

            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Fold quantum measurement-semantics law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001`

## WHY

Fold quantum measurement-semantics law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: total observation relation; retained observation class; closed branch distinctions; complete pre-observation record; selected-class state; exact reconstruction boundary.

Boundary:

> All finite measurement structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. No stochastic collapse postulate is imported; outcome frequencies require external empirical evidence.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced measurement kernel retains total observation relation; retained observation class; closed branch distinctions; complete pre-observation record; selected-class state; exact reconstruction boundary; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: total observation relation; retained observation class; closed branch distinctions; complete pre-observation record; selected-class state; exact reconstruction boundary.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact measurement record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-MEASUREMENT-001

## Boundary and exclusions

No stochastic collapse postulate is imported; outcome frequencies require external empirical evidence.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- No stochastic collapse postulate is imported; outcome frequencies require external empirical evidence.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: quantum measurement, collapse.

# Constrained motion, restoration and oscillation

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-MECH-CONSTRAINT-OSCILLATION-001`

## Why and derivation

A reversible constraint maps displacement orientation to a source-bound restoring transfer; finite repeated reversal forces a recurrence whose period is an exact transition count relative to the reference recurrence.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__reversible-restoring-recurrence__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Constrained reversible restoration generates a closed oscillation with exact recurrence count, held phase and conserved carrier trace.

The base certificate is: One generated physical event retains one state, one recurrence position and one complete observation trace.

The successor certificate is: Appending one event retains the prior trace, adds one source-bound transition and composes its exact duration, separation and transfer relations without changing earlier records.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Source, response and field carrier

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-SOURCE-RESPONSE-001`

## Why and derivation

A physical field is forced as the complete source-bound map from a localized distinction to every generated accessible response cell; a value detached from source and support is not a field.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__source-bound-support-map__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> A field is the complete finite map of a held source distinction through generated accessible support to source-bound response records.

The base certificate is: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Gravitational interaction at the weak relational boundary

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-GRAVITATIONAL-INTERACTION-001`

## Why and derivation

A gravitational response is forced as a universally source-linked relational change of free motion, with geometric support dilution and no held charge-family alternative.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__universal-inertial-source-response__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Weak relational gravitation is universal inertial-source response transported over generated support and observed as a free-motion change.

The base certificate is: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

# Electric field, potential and work correspondence

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-ELECTRIC-POTENTIAL-001`

## Why and derivation

Electric field response is force transfer per held charge carrier; potential difference is the exact work transfer per charge between two generated support relations.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__charge-normalized-force-and-work__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Electric field is charge-normalized force response and electric potential difference is charge-normalized work transfer between held endpoints.

The base certificate is: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Induction from changing linked support

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-INDUCTION-001`

## Why and derivation

A change in magnetic support linked through a closed generated path forces an oriented electric work-transfer trace around that path, preserving complete source-change provenance.

The exact result is:

> Induction maps exact change of linked magnetic support to held cyclic electric work transfer on the complete boundary path.

The base certificate is: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.

## Blind external check

prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and

and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Electric-magnetic compositional closure

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-ELECTROMAGNETIC-COMPOSITION-001`

## Why and derivation

Electric and magnetic responses are forced as two observation projections of one conserved oriented source/propagation structure, because each changing projection generates the other on a closed trace.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__joint-electric-magnetic-propagation__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Electromagnetism is the closed joint carrier of electric and magnetic response projections with common source, orientation and propagation trace.

The base certificate is: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(

                for row in rows

        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Local propagation and causal accessibility

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-LOCALITY-CAUSALITY-001`

## Why and derivation

A field response can change only through a generated adjacent transition path from its source; responses outside the completed propagation trace are inaccessible at that event.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__adjacent-source-bound-propagation__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Physical locality is source-bound propagation through generated adjacent support; causal accessibility is exactly the completed reachable path set.

The base certificate is: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

            root_theorems=(ROOT_THEOREM,),

            axioms=(),
            free_parameters=(),
            provenance=(ProvenanceClass.FORWARD_FORCING,),

        )

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Period, recurrence and frequency

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-WAVE-PERIOD-FREQUENCY-001`

## Why and derivation

A wave period is the exact positive transition count closing one recurrence relative to a held clock recurrence; frequency is the exact count of closed recurrences per duration.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__closed-recurrence-count-ratio__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Period and frequency are reciprocal exact positive recurrence ratios with complete phase and reference traces.

The base certificate is: One recurrent source transition appears at one adjacent response cell with its source, phase and recurrence identity retained.

The successor certificate is: Appending one recurrence or propagation cell retains every earlier phase/response record and adds exactly one source-bound transition.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Propagation speed, wavelength and frequency relation

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-WAVE-SPEED-LENGTH-FREQUENCY-001`

## Why and derivation

One recurrence transported through one spatial repeat forces propagation speed to equal exact wavelength support per period, equivalently wavelength composed with frequency.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__spatial-repeat-times-recurrence-rate__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Wave speed is exact wavelength/period, equivalently the exact product of wavelength and frequency.

The base certificate is: One recurrent source transition appears at one adjacent response cell with its source, phase and recurrence identity retained.

The successor certificate is: Appending one recurrence or propagation cell retains every earlier phase/response record and adds exactly one source-bound transition.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,

            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(

            self.spec.grammar_boundary,

        )

    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)

            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Wave interference and predecessor merging

## Why and derivation

retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__phase-labelled-predecessor-merging__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Interference is exact phase-labelled predecessor merging into common observation support with all source traces retained.

The base certificate is: One recurrent source transition appears at one adjacent response cell with its source, phase and recurrence identity retained.

The successor certificate is: Appending one recurrence or propagation cell retains every earlier phase/response record and adds exactly one source-bound transition.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )
