# Fold reversible transformation and gate law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001`

## WHY

Fold reversible transformation and gate law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: bijective branch-word map; period-held phase action; complete domain and image support; exact inverse; source-bound gate identity; composition interface.

Boundary:

> All finite quantum transformations and gates structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. Physical gate fidelity remains an empirical engineering question.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced quantum transformations and gates kernel retains bijective branch-word map; period-held phase action; complete domain and image support; exact inverse; source-bound gate identity; composition interface; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: bijective branch-word map; period-held phase action; complete domain and image support; exact inverse; source-bound gate identity; composition interface.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact quantum transformations and gates record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-GATE-001

## Boundary and exclusions

Physical gate fidelity remains an empirical engineering question.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- Physical gate fidelity remains an empirical engineering question.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: quantum gate, unitary transformation.

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: generated wires; information units; reversible gates; causal circuit order; complete branchwise evaluation; inverse circuit; observation boundary; resource ledger.

Boundary:

> All finite quantum circuits structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. This derives circuit semantics; hardware timing and noise are external.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced quantum circuits kernel retains generated wires; information units; reversible gates; causal circuit order; complete branchwise evaluation; inverse circuit; observation boundary; resource ledger; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: generated wires; information units; reversible gates; causal circuit order; complete branchwise evaluation; inverse circuit; observation boundary; resource ledger.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact quantum circuits record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

This derives circuit semantics; hardware timing and noise are external.

- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- This derives circuit semantics; hardware timing and noise are external.

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(self.spec.generation_rule, self.spec.grammar_boundary, len(records), sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)), tuple(Candidate(str(r["candidate_id"]), str(r["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, r))) for r in records))

decide_candidate — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:127
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

closure_evidence — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:133
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Fold quantum algorithm-family law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001`

## WHY

Fold quantum algorithm-family law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: complete input support; reversible branch generation; phase action; interference merge; observation decoder; correctness trace per branch; classical comparison boundary.

Boundary:

> All finite quantum algorithms structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. Named speedups require their own exact problem family and resource proof.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced quantum algorithms kernel retains complete input support; reversible branch generation; phase action; interference merge; observation decoder; correctness trace per branch; classical comparison boundary; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: complete input support; reversible branch generation; phase action; interference merge; observation decoder; correctness trace per branch; classical comparison boundary.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact quantum algorithms record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-ALGORITHMS-001

## Boundary and exclusions

Named speedups require their own exact problem family and resource proof.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- Named speedups require their own exact problem family and resource proof.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: quantum algorithm, quantum speedup.

decide_candidate — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:127
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

closure_evidence — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:133
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Fold quantum communication law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001`

## WHY

Fold quantum communication law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: sender and receiver supports; joint state composition; local transformations; channel relation; retained correlations; observation records; resource and loss ledger.

Boundary:

> All finite quantum communication structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. Physical transmission capacity and security require registered media experiments.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced quantum communication kernel retains sender and receiver supports; joint state composition; local transformations; channel relation; retained correlations; observation records; resource and loss ledger; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: sender and receiver supports; joint state composition; local transformations; channel relation; retained correlations; observation records; resource and loss ledger.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact quantum communication record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-COMMUNICATION-001

## Boundary and exclusions

Physical transmission capacity and security require registered media experiments.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- Physical transmission capacity and security require registered media experiments.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: quantum communication, teleportation.

- Support law: logical branch support; redundant joint words; reversible encoder; declared error actions; disjoint syndrome supports; decoder and reconstruction trace.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact quantum coding record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-CODING-001

## Boundary and exclusions

The code theorem applies only to the registered generated error family.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- The code theorem applies only to the registered generated error family.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: quantum code, encoding.

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(self.spec.generation_rule, self.spec.grammar_boundary, len(records), sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)), tuple(Candidate(str(r["candidate_id"]), str(r["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, r))) for r in records))

decide_candidate — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:127
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

closure_evidence — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:133
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Fold quantum error-correction law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-ERROR-CORRECTION-001`

## WHY

Fold quantum error-correction law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: forced repetition width 2t+1; exact fault-depth trace; all error masks through t; majority held-label decoder; syndrome ledger; recovery certificate.

Boundary:

> All finite quantum error correction structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. The completed census covers generated fault depths one, two and three and the successor law for every positive finite t.

Forced result:

Laws:

    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Fold quantum fault-tolerance law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001`

## WHY

Fold quantum fault-tolerance law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: encoded logical support; declared component faults; transversal or contained transformations; recovery after each location; malignant-fault boundary; induction over circuit locations.

Boundary:

> All finite fault-tolerant quantum computation structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. No hardware threshold constant is claimed; unlimited thresholds remain dependent on a separately derived physical fault model.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced fault-tolerant quantum computation kernel retains encoded logical support; declared component faults; transversal or contained transformations; recovery after each location; malignant-fault boundary; induction over circuit locations; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: encoded logical support; declared component faults; transversal or contained transformations; recovery after each location; malignant-fault boundary; induction over circuit locations.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact fault-tolerant quantum computation record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-FAULT-TOLERANCE-001

## Boundary and exclusions

No hardware threshold constant is claimed; unlimited thresholds remain dependent on a separately derived physical fault model.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- No hardware threshold constant is claimed; unlimited thresholds remain dependent on a separately derived physical fault model.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: fault tolerance, threshold theorem.

    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:

decide_candidate — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:127
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

closure_evidence — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:133
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Fold quantum verification law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001`

## WHY

Fold quantum verification law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: claim and witness supports; verifier circuit; challenge schedule; branchwise acceptance; soundness and completeness ledgers; measurement records; tamper controls.

Boundary:

> All finite quantum verification structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. Security and correctness are exact only for the registered prover and resource grammar.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced quantum verification kernel retains claim and witness supports; verifier circuit; challenge schedule; branchwise acceptance; soundness and completeness ledgers; measurement records; tamper controls; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: claim and witness supports; verifier circuit; challenge schedule; branchwise acceptance; soundness and completeness ledgers; measurement records; tamper controls.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact quantum verification record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-VERIFICATION-001

## Boundary and exclusions

Security and correctness are exact only for the registered prover and resource grammar.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- Security and correctness are exact only for the registered prover and resource grammar.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: quantum verification, QMA.

- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- No pretrained quantum model, fitted amplitude or unexplained speedup is admitted.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: quantum learning, quantum machine learning.

    def registration(self) -> ClaimRegistration:

generate_candidates — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:123
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(self.spec.generation_rule, self.spec.grammar_boundary, len(records), sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)), tuple(Candidate(str(r["candidate_id"]), str(r["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, r))) for r in records))

decide_candidate — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:127
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        record = next(r for r in candidate_records(self.spec) if r["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, record)
        return CandidateDecision(candidate.candidate_id, survives, reason, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, record, survives, reason)))

closure_evidence — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:133
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        proof = {"result": self.spec.exact_result, "laws": self.spec.laws, "base": self.spec.induction_base, "step": self.spec.induction_step, "witnesses": self.spec.witnesses, "decisions": tuple(decisions)}
        return ClosureEvidence(ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT, self.spec.grammar_boundary, True, True, sha256_identity(proof), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.induction_base, self.spec.induction_step)))

run_controls — sft/quantum_computation/generated_law.py:137
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Full operational classical-quantum correspondence law

Claim: `SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001`

## WHY

Full operational classical-quantum correspondence law must be forced from admitted Fold and computation laws before conventional quantum models may be compared.

## DERIVATION

Complete Fold-word support, exact information ledgers, reversible classical processes and pair-cell composition force the registered kernel: common generated descriptions; embedding of classical states; reversible classical submodel; branchwise quantum execution; measurement decoder; bidirectional result preservation; overhead ledger.

Boundary:

> All finite classical and quantum operational correspondence structures generated from admitted Fold words, distinction ledgers, classical computation and exact held phase labels. Correspondence does not identify the models where phase-sensitive joint support changes the operational trace.

The complete eight-axis product contains 256 generated candidates and exactly
one all-preserving member.

- `support` — `complete-generated-branch-support`: complete-generated-branch-support retains the required exact support structure.
- `unit` — `one-Fold-distinction-unit`: one-Fold-distinction-unit retains the required exact unit structure.
- `composition` — `complete-pair-cell-joint-support`: complete-pair-cell-joint-support retains the required exact composition structure.
- `phase` — `period-held-phase-action`: period-held-phase-action retains the required exact phase structure.
- `transformation` — `total-reversible-source-bound-map`: total-reversible-source-bound-map retains the required exact transformation structure.
- `observation` — `retained-class-and-complete-record`: retained-class-and-complete-record retains the required exact observation structure.
- `generality` — `branch-and-depth-successor-certificate`: branch-and-depth-successor-certificate retains the required exact generality structure.
- `addition` — `no-extra-quantum-premise`: no-extra-quantum-premise retains the required exact addition structure.

Forced result:

> The forced classical and quantum operational correspondence kernel retains common generated descriptions; embedding of classical states; reversible classical submodel; branchwise quantum execution; measurement decoder; bidirectional result preservation; overhead ledger; branch support, phase, transformation, observation, composition and resources remain exact, finite, source-bound and free of imported amplitudes or postulates.

Laws:

- Support law: common generated descriptions; embedding of classical states; reversible classical submodel; branchwise quantum execution; measurement decoder; bidirectional result preservation; overhead ledger.
- Phase law: period-held label actions transform branch provenance without imaginary or irrational proof values.
- Reversibility law: transformations are total bijections or retain the exact predecessor label needed for inversion.
- Observation law: selected support and every closed distinction remain reconstructible from the measurement record.
- Composition law: joint pair-cell words preserve component identity and explicitly classify factorable and nonfactorable support.

Base: One Fold distinction supplies the minimal two-label support and one exact classical and quantum operational correspondence record.

Successor: Adding one generated branch, component, fault position or circuit location appends all new joint cells, phase rows, transformations and observation distinctions while retaining prior records.

## CHECK

Execute all 256 structural candidates, decide every member, verify the sole survivor, replay eight quantum operational witnesses, exhaust fault masks at widths three, five and seven, run four controls and independently regenerate the product.

- `quantum-witness-1` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 1 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-2` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 2 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-3` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 3 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-4` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 4 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-5` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 5 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-6` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 6 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-7` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 7 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001
- `quantum-witness-8` — exact Fold quantum operational witness 8 for SFT-QUANTUM-CLASSICAL-CORRESPONDENCE-001

## Boundary and exclusions

Correspondence does not identify the models where phase-sensitive joint support changes the operational trace.

- no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
- no complex amplitude, Hilbert-space axiom or stochastic collapse postulate
- no completed infinity or ungenerated continuum
- no free, fitted, learned or hardware parameter
- no application output or physical measurement may select the law
- Correspondence does not identify the models where phase-sensitive joint support changes the operational trace.

Downstream conventional correspondence only: classical-quantum correspondence, deferred measurement.

    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        records = candidate_records(self.spec)
        admitted = [d.admitted_choice.name for d in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(c.name for c in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not c.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        false_record = next(r for r in records if r["candidate_id"] == false_id)
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        payloads = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, "reject incomplete state support", decision_reason(self.spec, false_record), false_id != survivor),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, "reject changed source identity", "changed source differs", sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, "reject altered survivor support", "one literal survivor", sum(r["candidate_id"] == survivor for r in records) == 1),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, "halt complex amplitude, stochastic collapse or imported quantum postulate", "; ".join(self.spec.boundary_exclusions), bool(self.spec.boundary_exclusions) and all(w.passed for w in self.spec.witnesses)),
        )
        return tuple(ControlResult(kind, passed, expected, observed, sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, expected, observed, passed))) for kind, expected, observed, passed in payloads)

# Physical quantum state correspondence

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-QUANTUM-PHYSICAL-STATE-001`

## Why and derivation

A physical quantum state is the complete generated support of distinguishable Fold words together with held phase/action and preparation provenance; it is not an answer-only amplitude list.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__complete-word-support-with-held-phase__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> The physical quantum state is complete finite Fold support with held phase/action and source-bound preparation trace.

The base certificate is: One physical Fold distinction occupies one generated support cell with its held state, phase/action and observation provenance.

The successor certificate is: Adding one support cell or constituent preserves every prior word, phase/action, composition and observation record and appends its complete lawful branches.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:

    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:

# Observable and measurement record

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-QUANTUM-OBSERVABLE-001`

## Why and derivation

A quantum observable is a generated partition of physical support into distinguishable record classes; measurement creates one retained source-bound record for the observed class.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__support-partition-to-retained-record__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> A physical observable is an exact support partition and measurement is its provenance-retaining record transition.

The base certificate is: One physical Fold distinction occupies one generated support cell with its held state, phase/action and observation provenance.

The successor certificate is: Adding one support cell or constituent preserves every prior word, phase/action, composition and observation record and appends its complete lawful branches.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Incompatible observations and uncertainty

## Why and derivation

retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,

> Quantum incompatibility is absence of a joint record-preserving refinement of two generated observation partitions.

The base certificate is: One physical Fold distinction occupies one generated support cell with its held state, phase/action and observation provenance.

The successor certificate is: Adding one support cell or constituent preserves every prior word, phase/action, composition and observation record and appends its complete lawful branches.

prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and

changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Spin and finite cyclic label action

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-QUANTUM-SPIN-001`

## Why and derivation

Physical spin is the finite cyclic held-label action of a constituent under generated orientation recurrence; opposite readings are fibre labels, never signed proof magnitudes.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__finite-cyclic-orientation-action__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Spin is finite cyclic orientation action on a physical Fold constituent with exact held measurement labels.

The base certificate is: One physical Fold distinction occupies one generated support cell with its held state, phase/action and observation provenance.

The successor certificate is: Adding one support cell or constituent preserves every prior word, phase/action, composition and observation record and appends its complete lawful branches.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Exclusion from antisymmetric composition

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-QUANTUM-EXCLUSION-001`

## Why and derivation

For the alternating held exchange class, two identical constituent labels cannot occupy the same one-constituent observation cell because exchange would erase the only distinguishing orientation trace.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__alternating-exchange-composition-exclusion__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Fermionic exclusion is absence of a distinct same-cell joint word under alternating held exchange composition.

The base certificate is: One physical Fold distinction occupies one generated support cell with its held state, phase/action and observation provenance.

The successor certificate is: Adding one support cell or constituent preserves every prior word, phase/action, composition and observation record and appends its complete lawful branches.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.
