    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Source continuity and field conservation

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-CONSERVED-SOURCE-001`

## Why and derivation

For every closed spacetime support region, a conserved source label can leave only through a named boundary transfer; the interior change and boundary flow are exact paired records.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__interior-change-boundary-flow-pairing__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Source continuity is exact pairing of interior carrier change with oriented boundary flow over complete generated support.

The base certificate is: One localized source distinction generates one named response relation on one accessible observation cell.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated source or observation cell appends its source-bound response and preserves all prior response, locality and transfer records.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

# Polarization as held transverse orientation

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-WAVE-POLARIZATION-001`

## Why and derivation

Polarization is forced as the held cyclic orientation class of a transverse field recurrence relative to its propagation path.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__held-transverse-recurrence-orientation__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Polarization is the held orientation of transverse recurrence support relative to wave propagation.

The base certificate is: One recurrent source transition appears at one adjacent response cell with its source, phase and recurrence identity retained.

The successor certificate is: Appending one recurrence or propagation cell retains every earlier phase/response record and adds exactly one source-bound transition.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,

            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Wave energy and momentum transport

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-WAVE-ENERGY-MOMENTUM-001`

## Why and derivation

A propagating recurrence that performs work at a remote response cell necessarily transports the corresponding energy carrier and held propagation momentum along its complete causal path.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__causal-wave-transfer-carrier__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Wave propagation transports exact energy and oriented momentum carriers, paired at source, path and response.

The base certificate is: One recurrent source transition appears at one adjacent response cell with its source, phase and recurrence identity retained.

The successor certificate is: Appending one recurrence or propagation cell retains every earlier phase/response record and adds exactly one source-bound transition.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Temperature carrier and thermal ordering

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-THERMO-TEMPERATURE-001`

## Why and derivation

Temperature is forced as the exact ordering carrier comparing energy-support change with accessible-state multiplicity change relative to one held thermal reference.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__energy-support-to-accessible-state-order__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Temperature is an exact reference-relative order of energy support per accessible-state change, not an imported continuum coordinate.

The base certificate is: One generated microscopic transition carries one exact energy-transfer record into one named macro-observation class.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated microscopic state or transition preserves every earlier state, class and transfer record and appends exactly its source-bound observation relation.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Heat and work as distinct energy-transfer traces

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-THERMO-HEAT-WORK-001`

## Why and derivation

Heat is energy transfer whose microscopic carrier label is closed by the receiving macro-observation; work is energy transfer whose organized source-to-response label remains observable.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__closed-label-versus-held-label-energy-transfer__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Heat and work are the closed-label and held-label observation classes of exact energy transfer.

The base certificate is: One generated microscopic transition carries one exact energy-transfer record into one named macro-observation class.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated microscopic state or transition preserves every earlier state, class and transfer record and appends exactly its source-bound observation relation.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Thermodynamic entropy from unresolved support

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-THERMO-ENTROPY-001`

## Why and derivation

Thermodynamic entropy is forced as the exact information required to distinguish the generated microscopic predecessors merged by a macro-observation, conditioned on every retained macro-label.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__conditional-unresolved-microstate-support__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Thermodynamic entropy is exact conditional unresolved support of a macro-observation over its finite generated microstates.

The base certificate is: One generated microscopic transition carries one exact energy-transfer record into one named macro-observation class.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated microscopic state or transition preserves every earlier state, class and transfer record and appends exactly its source-bound observation relation.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

# Finite unattainability boundary

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-THERMO-THIRD-LAW-001`

## Why and derivation

No positive finite transition sequence can erase the final generated recurrence distinction of a material support; complete recurrence closure is therefore a limiting boundary rather than a reachable destructive state.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__positive-transition-unattainability__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> The minimum thermal recurrence boundary cannot be reached by erasing all distinction through a finite lawful process.

The base certificate is: One generated microscopic transition carries one exact energy-transfer record into one named macro-observation class.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated microscopic state or transition preserves every earlier state, class and transfer record and appends exactly its source-bound observation relation.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Phase coexistence and transition

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-THERMO-PHASE-EQUILIBRIUM-001`

## Why and derivation

Distinct macroscopic phase classes coexist when their exchange boundary preserves a common thermal order and reciprocal transfer balance; a phase transition changes the selected observation fibre while retaining total provenance.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__coexisting-observation-fibres-under-balanced-exchange__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Phase coexistence is balanced exchange between distinct structural observation fibres; transition is provenance-preserving fibre change.

The base certificate is: One generated microscopic transition carries one exact energy-transfer record into one named macro-observation class.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated microscopic state or transition preserves every earlier state, class and transfer record and appends exactly its source-bound observation relation.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Finite fluctuation and recurrence

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-THERMO-FLUCTUATION-001`

## Why and derivation

A thermal fluctuation is a finite departure of an observed fibre count or transfer count from its recurrence class; complete deterministic support fixes every departure and return path.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__finite-count-departure-and-recurrence__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Thermal fluctuations are exact finite count changes across deterministic Fold paths, weighted only by complete support census.

The base certificate is: One generated microscopic transition carries one exact energy-transfer record into one named macro-observation class.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated microscopic state or transition preserves every earlier state, class and transfer record and appends exactly its source-bound observation relation.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Susceptibility, response and transport correspondence

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-THERMO-RESPONSE-001`

## Why and derivation

Thermal response is the exact change of one registered observation carrier per exact change of its source carrier, conditioned on the same held support and recurrence class.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__exact-source-response-change-ratio__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Susceptibility and transport are exact source-conditioned response ratios on a declared finite observation support.

The base certificate is: One generated microscopic transition carries one exact energy-transfer record into one named macro-observation class.

The successor certificate is: Adding one generated microscopic state or transition preserves every earlier state, class and transfer record and appends exactly its source-bound observation relation.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Density as exact content-to-support relation

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FLUID-DENSITY-001`

## Why and derivation

Density is the exact positive material-content count or inertial carrier divided by the generated spatial support count of the same observation region.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__content-over-generated-support__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Fluid density is an exact content-to-support ratio on a complete generated region.

The base certificate is: One generated cell carries one exact content record, boundary adjacency and local transfer state.

The successor certificate is: Adding one cell preserves every prior content, adjacency, boundary and transfer trace and appends exactly its source-bound local relations.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)

        return CandidateDecision(

        )

# Flow conservation

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FLUID-CONSERVATION-001`

## Why and derivation

For every complete cell region, material, momentum and energy changes pair exactly with named transfers across its generated boundary.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__interior-change-boundary-flux-pairing__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Fluid conservation is exact pairing of interior carrier change with oriented boundary flow.

The base certificate is: One generated cell carries one exact content record, boundary adjacency and local transfer state.

The successor certificate is: Adding one cell preserves every prior content, adjacency, boundary and transfer trace and appends exactly its source-bound local relations.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Finite turbulence and cascade boundary

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-FLUID-TURBULENCE-001`

## Why and derivation

Finite turbulence is nonperiodic multi-scale recurrence on a complete flow network, with conserved carriers transferred among generated support refinements; cascade claims close only at the enumerated scale boundary.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__multiscale-flow-recurrence-transfer__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Turbulence is deterministic multiscale Fold flow with exact carrier transfer and an explicit finite census boundary.

The base certificate is: One generated cell carries one exact content record, boundary adjacency and local transfer state.

The successor certificate is: Adding one cell preserves every prior content, adjacency, boundary and transfer trace and appends exactly its source-bound local relations.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Plasma oscillation and screening

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-PLASMA-OSCILLATION-001`

## Why and derivation

Displacing held charge orientations creates a restoring field recurrence; phase-mixed mobile responses redistribute until distant observation classes close the source distinction, producing screening.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__charge-separation-restoring-recurrence__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Plasma oscillation is charge-separation recurrence and screening is closure of its source distinction by complete mobile response.

The base certificate is: One generated cell carries one exact content record, boundary adjacency and local transfer state.

The successor certificate is: Adding one cell preserves every prior content, adjacency, boundary and transfer trace and appends exactly its source-bound local relations.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

        return ClaimRegistration(
            claim_id=self.spec.claim_id,
            title=self.spec.title,
            branch="physics",
            statement=self.spec.statement,
            evidence_mode=EvidenceMode.EMPIRICAL,
            root_theorems=(ROOT_THEOREM,),
            dependencies=self.spec.dependencies,
            axioms=(),
            free_parameters=(),
            provenance=(ProvenanceClass.FORWARD_FORCING,),
            source_hash=self.source_hash,
        )

generate_candidates — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:199
    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            expected_cardinality=len(rows),
            completeness_certificate_hash=sha256_identity(completeness_record(self.spec)),
            candidates=tuple(
                Candidate(str(row["candidate_id"]), str(row["exact_form"]), sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, row)))
                for row in rows
            ),
        )

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

closure_evidence — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:223
    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

run_controls — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:242
    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)
        false_id = "__".join((rejected, *admitted[1:]))
        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)
        records = (
            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_SOURCE, sha256_identity({"changed": self.source_hash}) != self.source_hash, "reject a changed registered source identity"),
            (ControlKind.TAMPERED_ARTIFACT, sum(row["candidate_id"] == survivor for row in rows) == 1, "reject a missing, duplicate or additional survivor"),
            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
            for kind, passed, description in records
        )

# Lattice order and excitation

Claim: `SFT-PHYS-CONDENSED-LATTICE-001`

## Why and derivation

A lattice is a finite adjacency network whose local constituent word and neighbor relation recur under generated translations; excitation is a source-bound departure propagated through that recurrence.

The complete registered eight-axis product contains 256 forms. Exactly one form
retains the complete Fold carrier, the forced relation, source-bound proof,
capability-closed prediction, a separate measurement record, all rows, a
One/successor certificate and no extra rule:

`complete-fold-carrier__translation-recurrent-adjacency-network__source-bound-proof-trace__capability-closed-prediction__separate-measurement-record__complete-registered-rows__one-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

The exact result is:

> Condensed lattice order is translation recurrence of a finite Fold adjacency network and excitation is its propagated labelled deviation.

The base certificate is: One generated cell carries one exact content record, boundary adjacency and local transfer state.

The successor certificate is: Adding one cell preserves every prior content, adjacency, boundary and transfer trace and appends exactly its source-bound local relations.

## Blind external check

The target custodian commits 2 externally sourced rows before the Fold
prediction runs. The predictor receives only the sealed derivation premise and
has no filesystem, network, process, clock, environment, import or foreign-
function instruction. After sealing, the evaluator opens every committed row,
performs the registered exact label comparison and rejects a deliberately
changed unfavorable row. Any omitted or mismatched row falsifies the registered
claim boundary.

This correspondence does not allow the external body to select the Fold relation
and does not convert a reported decimal inscription into a proof value.

ORIGINAL DERIVATION DOCUMENT — claims/SFT-MAT-SEMI-JUNCTION-001/WHY_DERIVATION_CHECK.md
# p-n junction and depletion organization

Claim: `SFT-MAT-SEMI-JUNCTION-001`

## WHY

Joining opposed doped regions forces interfacial carrier transfer until a retained depletion/space-charge organization balances transport and field response at declared conditions.

## DERIVATION

Dependencies: `SFT-FOUNDATION-FORM-ENFORCEMENT-001`, `SFT-MATH-EXACT-ARITHMETIC-001`, `SFT-MATH-DISCRETE-001`, `SFT-MATH-COMBINATORICS-001`, `SFT-MATH-GRAPH-NETWORK-001`, `SFT-MATH-ORDER-LATTICE-001`, `SFT-MATH-GEOMETRY-TOPOLOGY-001`, `SFT-MATH-DYNAMICAL-SYSTEMS-001`, `SFT-MATH-LOGIC-PROOF-001`, `SFT-INFO-SYMBOL-DISTINCTION-001`, `SFT-INFO-CONSERVATION-LOSS-001`, `SFT-PHYS-MECH-CONSERVATION-001`, `SFT-PHYS-QUANTUM-EXCLUSION-001`, `SFT-PHYS-FIELD-ELECTRIC-DISTINCTION-001`, `SFT-PHYS-CONDENSED-BAND-001`

Boundary: Every positive finite generated Materials carrier in the registered electronic_semiconductor grammar that preserves opposed-doped-region-carrier, cross-interface-carrier-transfer, space-charge-and-field-retained and equilibrium-and-bias-bounded.

Generation: Generate the literal Cartesian product of the registered content-specific carrier, relation, organization and observation choices with record, provenance, generality and extension choices.

The literal eight-axis product contains 256 forms:

- `carrier` — rejected `carrier-erased-or-answer-only`: Erasing the material carrier prevents reconstruction of the observed distinction. Admitted `opposed-doped-region-carrier`: The complete generated material carrier is retained.
- `relation` — rejected `relation-imported-fitted-or-erased`: An imported, fitted or absent relation can select a familiar answer without forcing it. Admitted `cross-interface-carrier-transfer`: Only the generated constituent, adjacency, transfer or response relation is admitted.
- `organization` — rejected `organization-collapsed`: Collapsing organization merges materials states that the question requires to remain distinct. Admitted `space-charge-and-field-retained`: Every organization, interface, history or boundary distinction required by the claim remains held.
- `observation` — rejected `observation-boundary-unrecorded`: An unrecorded method, scale or condition cannot identify the Materials observation class. Admitted `equilibrium-and-bias-bounded`: The exact declared observation boundary is retained and cannot select the law.
- `record` — rejected `result-without-state-transition-record`: A result label without its state, transition and boundary trace is not auditable. Admitted `complete-state-transition-boundary-trace`: The complete initial state, transition, result and retained/lost distinctions are recorded.
- `provenance` — rejected `authority-or-target-selected-law`: Authority, consensus, a handbook or target data may test but cannot select a Fold law. Admitted `root-bound-forward-forcing`: Every decision is traced through admitted dependencies to the premise-free root theorem.
- `generality` — rejected `single-specimen-or-instance-lookup`: One favorable specimen or instance does not close the generated class. Admitted `positive-finite-successor-closure`: The base carrier and every positive finite successor preserve the relation at the declared boundary.
- `extension` — rejected `free-fit-exception-or-extra-rule`: A free coefficient, fit, exception or added constitutive law can force a desired answer. Admitted `no-extra-rule`: No rule beyond the admitted Fold dependencies and generated preservation conditions is present.

Exactly one form preserves every registered coordinate:

`opposed-doped-region-carrier__cross-interface-carrier-transfer__space-charge-and-field-retained__equilibrium-and-bias-bounded__complete-state-transition-boundary-trace__root-bound-forward-forcing__positive-finite-successor-closure__no-extra-rule`

Base: One complete material carrier retains its generated relation, organization, observation boundary and proof record.

Successor: Adding one generated constituent, cell, interface, transition or observation row preserves every earlier distinction and appends its exact source-bound relation without an extra rule.

## CHECK

The complete 84-law prediction set and 21,504 candidates were sealed before
source identities were selected. The prediction program has no filesystem,
network, clock, environment, dynamic-import or subprocess capability. After
the prediction seal, a distinct custodian opens every byte-sealed NIST/BIPM
source, requires every claim-specific fragment, retains all rows, and compares
the source-derived held record. A changed record must fail.

This law predicts a conditional structural relation. It does not turn a specimen- and method-dependent magnitude into a universal constant.

External authority tests the consequence; it does not select the Fold grammar.

    def generate_candidates(self) -> CandidateCensus:

        return CandidateCensus(
            generation_rule=self.spec.generation_rule,
            grammar_boundary=self.spec.grammar_boundary,

            candidates=tuple(

decide_candidate — sft/physics/generated_empirical_law.py:212
    def decide_candidate(self, candidate: Candidate) -> CandidateDecision:
        row = next(row for row in candidate_rows(self.spec) if row["candidate_id"] == candidate.candidate_id)
        survives = candidate.candidate_id == survivor_id(self.spec)
        reason = decision_reason(self.spec, row)
        return CandidateDecision(
            candidate.candidate_id,
            survives,
            reason,
            sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, self.spec.dependencies, row, survives, reason)),
        )

    def closure_evidence(self, decisions: Sequence[CandidateDecision]) -> ClosureEvidence:
        record = {
            "claim_id": self.spec.claim_id,
            "result": self.spec.exact_result,
            "base": self.spec.induction_base,
            "successor": self.spec.induction_step,
            "exclusions": self.spec.exclusions,
            "witnesses": self.spec.operational_witnesses,
            "survivor": survivor_id(self.spec),
        }
        return ClosureEvidence(
            ClosureScope.DEPTH_INDEPENDENT,
            self.spec.grammar_boundary,
            True,
            True,
            sha256_identity((record, tuple(decisions))),
            sha256_identity(record),
        )

    def run_controls(self) -> tuple[ControlResult, ...]:
        rows = candidate_rows(self.spec)
        admitted = [dimension.admitted_choice.name for dimension in self.spec.dimensions]
        rejected = next(choice.name for choice in self.spec.dimensions[0].choices if not choice.admitted)

        survivor = survivor_id(self.spec)

            (ControlKind.FALSE_PREMISE, false_id != survivor, "reject the generated form lacking the complete physical carrier"),

            (ControlKind.BOUNDARY, bool(self.spec.exclusions), "reject target access, forbidden proof values, imported laws and free parameters"),
        )
        return tuple(
            ControlResult(kind, passed, description, description if passed else "control failed", sha256_identity((self.spec.claim_id, kind.value, passed, description)))
